Name: Seeds N' Saplings
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/AglQjMs.png[/img]﻿[/center]

Seeds N' Saplings is my go at a retexture of Stardew Valley's seed items, along with a few extra non-seed items, to match what I like aesthetically and playstyle. I was inspired by other modders and artists such as Tai, Airyn, 6480, Mizu, Wildflour, Himetarts, Gwen and more. 

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Aj354v4.png[/img][/center]
﻿﻿
[left][u][b]Seasonal Seedbags and Saplings
[/b][/u]This option colour codes seedbags to their farming season, and saplings to their harvest/fruiting season. Green for spring, pink for summer, brown for autumn and blue for winter, just like the craftable wild seed bags. This is especially handy in case you happen to be forgetful like me and have many modded crops. There are two different Seasonal Options.

[b][u]Non Seasonal Seedbags and Saplings
[/u][/b]With this option, seedbags stay the same colour all year around, and has six different colour options to choose from.

[b][u]Multiple Designs
[/u][/b]Some seedbags have different designs for you to choose from, ranging from different sizes or selecting between a sack or bag.

[u][b]Seedbags for bagless seeds
[/b][/u]Seeds that had no seedbags have an option to come in a seedbag. These are [i]disabled by default.[/i]

[u][b]Seasonal Sapling Leaves
[/b][/u]The leaves on saplings will change with the seasons depending on the fully grown tree or bush. [i]Disabled by default.[/i]

[u][b]Different Sapling Designs
[/b][/u]You can pick between the usual, vanilla game's sack or a garden pot for tree saplings.

[u][b]Darker Wood 'Medieval' Crop Textures
[/b][/u]On crops that come with wooden trellis, there's options for a darker wood colour, particularly to fit with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Gweniaczek?gameId=1303]Gwen's Medieval Series[/url] or [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch?gameId=1303]Bog's[/url]﻿ [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods?gameId=1303]Witchy series[/url][/left]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/CnHPI1a.png[/img][/center]
[left]This mod, like my others, is completely [i][b]configurable[/b][/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable! You rather use Tai's amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] for seedbags and saplings but want to use Seed N' Sapling's grass starter textures? You can do just that! 

[list]
[*]All seedbags, bush saplings and crops can be disabled.
[/list][list]
[*][u][b]Seasonal Seedbags:[/b][/u] Select whether you want the seeds, just standard crop seeds, to be Non Seasonal or Seasonal.
[*][u][b]Non Seasonal Seedbag Colour:[/b][/u] Select what colour you want for Non Seasonal seedbags. If you do not want Non Seasonal Seedbags, you can ignore this.
[*][u][b]Seasonal Seedbag Colour:[/b][/u] Select what 'colour', standard or faded colours, you want for Seasonal seedbags. If you do not want Seasonal Seedbags, you can ignore this.
[/list][list]
[*][u][b]Seasonal Bush Saplings:[/b][/u]  Select whether you want the bush saplings to be Non Seasonal or Seasonal.
[*][u][b]Non Seasonal Bush Saplings Colour:[/b][/u] Select what colour you want for Non Seasonal bush saplings. If you do not want Non Seasonal bush saplings, you can ignore this.
[*][u][/u][u][b]Seasonal Bush Saplings Colour:[/b][/u] Select what 'colour', standard or faded colours, you want for Seasonal bush saplings. If you do not want Seasonal bush saplings, you can ignore this.
[*][u][b]Seasonally Changing Bush Leaves:[/b][/u] The bush saplings that have leaves will change with the season to match their mature bush. This is [i]disabled by default[/i].
[/list][list]
[*][u][b]Seasonal Saplings:[/b][/u]  Select whether you want the fruit tree saplings to be Non Seasonal or Seasonal.
[*][b][u]No[/u][/b][u][b]n Seasonal Saplings Colour:[/b][/u] Select what colour you want for Non Seasonal saplings. If you do not want Non Seasonal saplings, you can ignore this.
[*][b][u]Seasonal [/u][/b][u][b]Saplings Colour:[/b][/u] Select what 'colour', standard or faded colours, you want for Seasonal  saplings. If you do not want Seasonal saplings, you can ignore this.
[*][b][u]Se[/u][/b][u][b]asonally Changing Bush Leaves:[/b][/u] The saplings that have leaves will change with the season to match their mature fruit tree. This is [i]disabled by default[/i].
[/list][/left]

[center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/PoStKKx.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play
